top_comments.author: @MountainDude-y5m
top_comments.text: Just spent the morning exploring Fable 5's new limits. Reminds me of debugging reward hacking. Shifting targets make verification impossible. Turns out competitive pressure behaves a lot like a mispecified reward function.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: That’s a perfect analogy — when the goalposts keep moving you can’t actually verify anything, you just end up chasing whatever the system is optimizing for this week. Feels exactly like reward hacking, but at a product level. Have you found any way to test reliably around it, or are you just waiting to see what the “real” limits settle at?
